name: Ta de Shouliechang
source:
"The Prey’s Game" is a dark romantic visual novel where you, a revenge-driven heroine, must survive and manipulate six dangerous, obsessive men. Every choice determines if you end as prey or hunter. Navigate a web of lethal attraction with over 30 possible endings.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134430/The_Preys_Game/]Steam[/url]]
